title: New Zealand
lead: University Entrance rules, schools offering IB, and where NZ IB students go next.

ue.title: University Entrance (UE)
ue.body: A full IB Diploma with at least 24 points meets University Entrance at every New Zealand university. Students studying in New Zealand must also meet literacy (English Language A at HL/SL, or English Language B at HL) and numeracy (any mathematics).

universities.title: New Zealand universities
universities.note: 24 points plus a full diploma is the entrance threshold only. Individual programmes such as medicine, engineering and law set higher points, subject and interview requirements - always check the university's own page.
